scientific_limitations: Classification applies only to K-linear automorphisms of the four-element dihedral quandle algebra over fields of characteristic 2. It does not classify larger even dihedral orders, coefficient rings with zero divisors, or semilinear maps. Numerical verification is limited to fields of sizes 2,4,8; mathematical proof is all-fields. Published-prior novelty is not independently certified.
title: A characteristic-two shear group for the four-element dihedral quandle algebra
